content: megajs (mega.js) is the maintained unofficial JS SDK for MEGA, v1.3.10 as of 2026, published on npm. Ships browser UMD (main.browser-umd.js) and ESM (main.browser-es.js) builds where Node-specific modules are swapped for browser equivalents. Supports login via Storage(email,password) + 'ready' event, .upload() for uploads, File.fromURL()/downloadBuffer() for downloads including shared links. Only part of the file API implemented (no chat/contacts). MEGA is end-to-end encrypted; the SDK handles client-side crypto.
